# Advanced, Hybrid & Agentic RAG — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 2 — Route 20 real questions

*Module 2: Hybrid systems and routing · about 48 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_route_twenty_questions.py`): Take 20 questions from your own logs. Label the correct route by hand, run the router, and read the misroute log. Each misroute is a rule or an example you are missing.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Multi-hop question set

*Module 3: GraphRAG and multimodal · about 48 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_graph_multihop.py`): Write five multi-hop questions about your own organisation (who approves X for people in Y?). Try them on plain RAG first. Which entities and relations would your graph need?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Agent loop with caps

*Module 4: Agentic retrieval · about 48 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_agentic_retrieval_loop.py`): Set max_steps to 1, then 3, then 6 on your own hard questions. Plot accuracy against cost. Where does the curve flatten?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 5 — Cost model

*Module 5: Smart routing economics · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_routing_economics_model.py`): Put your own traffic mix into MIX (from a hand-labelled sample of 100 questions). What is your saving? What misroute rate would wipe it out?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
